item.title: Kokoro Rista!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Q-X
  • 発売日: 2015-10-30
  • スコア: 7.24/10 (62 人評価)
  • 日本語名: こころリスタ！
  • 英語名: Kokoro Rista!

别名

  • こころリスタ！ cocoro Restarter！-COCORO NAVI System 2.0x-

あらすじ

This is the sequel to Q-X’s 2003 title Kokoro Navi. In the near future, the otaku world which had been somewhat accepted into society returned underground as a result of large-scale regulations. The regulations then began to spill over to the Internet and even the once popular communication tool IRIS showed signs of decline with the departure of many occasional users.

item.title: Gengetsu no Pandora
item.description:

  • ブランド: Q-X
  • 発売日: 2009-12-25
  • スコア: 6.7/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 幻月のパンドオラ
  • 英語名: Gengetsu no Pandora

あらすじ

One day, Fumiki joins the game research club. When he goes to the club room, hot water suddenly comes out from the ground! Also, a girl appears in front of him and plugs a cable into his chest. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself being in a digital world. There, a girl suddenly appears and says to him, “Collect some data of human desire…”

item.title: Hime-sama Ririshiku!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Q-X
  • 発売日: 2006-06-23
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫さま凛々しく！
  • 英語名: Hime-sama Ririshiku!

あらすじ

He is wandering around the forest. He doesn’t know where he is, why he is there. The only things he remembers are his name and his position that he is a prince of a country. The prince meets a mysterious girl named Chinaki. She has also lost her memory but it seemed she came from another world. There is one more thing that he is sure…. that he is lecherous. He dosen’t know about love but likes girls. Thanks to a fairy named Hana, they get out of the forest and come to a house where the King lives. The prince is informed that one year has already passed since he disappeared. However, the prince doesn’t take this fact seriously, just thinks about erotic things. The king orders him to act more decently. Will he be able to change his behaviors and know the real love?
